## Concept (one line)
A LinkedIn twist film: looks like an ordinary company (debate, chat,
presentation, founder review) → reveals it's all **AI agents** → the one human
is the **founder**. Ends: "This is how Kneaded.ai works."

## Locked decisions
- **Surprise structure:** Act 1 reads FULLY HUMAN (NO "agent/AI/Claude" labels);
  AI versions appear ONLY in the Act 2 replay overlays. (Do not leak the twist.)

  friendly visible person (not a scary silhouette).
- **Narration:** ElevenLabs (Jessica), brand spoken as "Kneaded A.I."

**CAPCUT-OWNED PIPELINE — ARCHITECTURE TO DESIGN (user, 06-03, important; not built yet):**
Shift the delivery model: instead of stems, I OWN/RECONSTRUCT the CapCut project JSON
(`draft_content.json`) via `capcut-cli` (+ direct JSON edits). Each new version = a NEW CapCut
project that is a CLONE of the user's latest edit (e.g. 0603: slow-mo reveal, music A→silence→B,
re-synced VO, fades) with ONLY the changed material swapped (new clip / new VO line / new plate).
So: map the current CapCut project structure, then make targeted material replacements — the EDIT
(timing, 0.36× speeds, music placement, fades) is preserved, carried project-to-project.
1. **Reconstruct/clone the CapCut JSON** programmatically (capcut-cli can build/edit; can also just
   copy the JSON and swap material refs). Deliver v2.10 AS a ready CapCut project that already looks
   like 0603, minus the one thing being replaced.
2. **Raw material must have NO baked FADES** (and per #3, no baked VO). Reason: when the user changes
   SPEED in CapCut (e.g. slowed the empty rooms), baked fade-in/out stretch and break. Keep renders
   clean/raw; apply fade-in/out IN CapCut (via JSON/CLI) so they're speed-independent. → assembler
   should emit a fade-free "raw" variant for the CapCut path.
3. **Deliver CLEAN video with NO baked VO** + separate VO track. The 0603 stems forced the user to
   extract VO from the MP4 to avoid DOUBLING with the provided voiceover_only.m4a. Fix: the CapCut
   video stem must be picture-only (no VO), VO supplied separately.

**RESEARCH DONE (06-03):** web + reddit survey of CapCut/JianYing `draft_content.json` parsers/builders.
KEY VERDICT — pipeline is feasible; the schema is FLAT/DECOUPLED, which makes single-material-swap clean:
a segment carries `material_id` (the file) + `extra_material_refs[]` (UUIDs of companion objects —
`materials.speeds[]`, `materials.audio_fades[]`, transitions, masks, animations). So the 0.36× slow-mo,
fades, and music are SEPARATE objects referenced by UUID; swapping a clip = repoint that video material's
`path` + `material_id` and every effect survives because none reference the file. Timing in microseconds
(`target_timerange`=timeline pos, `source_timerange`=trim into source). Media referenced by ABSOLUTE
`path` + MD5 `material_id` on the material object (must match across `draft_content.json`/`draft_info.json`
AND `draft_meta_info.json`). Encryption: JianYing 6.0+ encrypts; **CapCut desktop 6–9 = plain JSON** (our
good case). TOOLS: lead = **pyCapCut** (`GuanYixuan/pyCapCut`, CapCut namespace, template mode = replace
material by name/segment/text, preserves companion refs); schema-truth + deterministic fallback =
**capcut-cli v0.9.0** (`renezander030`, TS, `docs/draft-schema/`; NOTE: different tool from our local
`capcut-cli` v0.4.0); pattern-source = pyJianYingDraft (3.4k★, JianYing namespace — don't run vs CapCut).
TOP 3 RISKS: (1) SOURCE-DURATION MISMATCH — a replacement clip shorter than the 0.36×-stretched
`source_timerange` breaks slow-mo; must recompute timeranges (what `replace_material` helpers do), not
just repoint path. (2) VERSION/NAMESPACE/ENCRYPTION — wrong version stamp → CapCut refuses ("newer
version"); CapCut-vs-JianYing enum mismatch; `masks`→`common_masks` at 9.6; re-stamp on clone. (3) DUAL-FILE
`path`+`material_id`+`import_time` consistency or CapCut relinks/shows old clip. PRACTITIONER RULE (matches
our design): never let the LLM hand-edit the JSON (µs ints, UTF-16 text offsets) — LLM proposes, typed
CLI/library executes, schema gates the contract.

via capcut-cli: lint exit 0; only seg 1 swapped; 0.36× slow-mo (seg 2), all 3 audio_fades, all 4 tracks
(music A/B + VO/sub-bass) INTACT.** ROUND-TRIP WORKS — CapCut opened the hand-edited clone, preserved
the entire edit. **CAVEAT FOUND:** new clip in a NEW folder (`output/poc-capcut/`) triggered CapCut's
"Couldn't find imported media / Link media" dialog ("File not accessible") even though the file exists —
sandbox/authorized-folder scope (originals in `output/stems-v2.9.1/` resolved fine). ROOT CAUSE FOUND:
**CapCut.app IS macOS-SANDBOXED** (`codesign -d --entitlements`: `app-sandbox`,
`files.bookmarks.app-scope`+`document-scope`, `files.user-selected.read-write`). It can only open a
file it holds a SECURITY-SCOPED BOOKMARK for — created when the USER picks the file via CapCut's import
dialog. Originals (in `output/stems-v2.9.1/`) each got a per-file bookmark at import; our injected clip
has none → "Couldn't find imported media / File not accessible" EVEN WITH a correct path + same folder.
**No JSON edit can grant this** (by macOS design — there is NO "imported-media list" file to patch; the
grant is an opaque per-file bookmark, not a path string). `draft_virtual_store.json` (lib-id list) and
`key_value.json` (per-segment analytics meta keyed by segmentId) reference media but are NOT the access
grant. Tests that FAILED to clear the prompt: (1) new clip in a new folder; (2) clip copied into the
already-authorized `stems-v2.9.1/`. **✅ SOLVED:** bundling the clip INSIDE the draft folder
(`0603-poc-swap/Resources/import/poc_swap_clip.mp4`) + repoint → CapCut opens it with NO relink prompt
(user-confirmed 06-03). CapCut has bookmark-free access to its own `~/Movies/CapCut/User Data` draft
tree, so media living there needs no security-scoped bookmark. **PIPELINE RULE (LOCKED): every clip a
new version introduces MUST be copied into `<project>/Resources/import/` and referenced by that bundled
path — never by an external `review-room/` path** (external paths are unopenable without CapCut's own
import bookmark). Reusing media CapCut already imported needs no click either. **POC FULLY GREEN — both
halves proven: (1) JSON material swap preserves slow-mo/fades/music/VO; (2) bundled-media ingest = zero
manual relink.**

### CAPCUT-OWNED PIPELINE — SWAP RECIPE (proven, ready to codify)
Per new version, from a clone of the latest hand-edit:
1. `cp -R <latest-project> <new-project>` (clone whole draft folder).
2. For each replaced material: copy new clip into `<new-project>/Resources/import/`; patch in BOTH
   `draft_info.json` copies (root + `Timelines/<id>/`) the material `path`/`media_path`/`duration`/
   `material_name`/`local_material_id`; add a `draft_meta_info.json` `draft_materials` library entry
   (new uuid id == new local_material_id); register that id in `draft_virtual_store.json` (type==1 list).
3. Re-stamp clone identity (`draft_name`/`draft_id`/`draft_fold_path` in draft_meta_info) + register in
   `root_meta_info.json` (`all_draft_store` clone-entry + `draft_ids`); backup root first.
4. `capcut-cli lint <project>` must exit 0.
